description: LAFU Search rules for one search: pin items first (pin = item ids like p123), hide items (hide), send to a page (redirect, on your own site), search for other words instead (replace_query) or filter (in_stock, tax_*/attr_*). match exact or contains; optional from/to (date or unix time). action list (default), set, delete (id). Changes need confirm.

action.description: list is default; set and delete need confirm.

filter.description: in_stock / on_sale true, or tax_* / attr_* value lists.

pin.description: Item ids shown first, e.g. p123 (post id with p, term with t).

query.description: The search words the rule reacts to.

redirect.description: A page on your own site.

site.description: LAFU Search site: OMA id or domain. Optional when the account has one site.

name: oma_pika_rules
title: LAFU Search rules
